# Ingo Swann — source-lead dossier

Swann’s books, visual work and autobiographical accounts are separate source genres. The estate’s presentation offers a starting bibliography, while institutional records offer a different route into remote-viewing research. Neither route automatically validates personal accounts of extraordinary events. This profile does not infer organizational connections from names appearing together.

## Works and original-source leads
1. **Natural ESP** — listed on the [official works page](https://ingoswann.com/works), **BPS-S02**. Its description presents ESP as a capacity of ordinary awareness. Publisher-description scope only; no edition title page or book chapter read.
2. **Penetration / Updated Special Edition** — same works page, **BPS-S02**. The publisher describes a covert-program memoir with nonhuman-intelligence and Moon accounts. The editions must remain separate; neither publication date nor underlying accounts were independently authenticated here.
3. **Remote Viewing: The Real Story** — same works index, **BPS-S02**, offers an out-of-print download. The existence of this route is bibliographic discovery, not a completed manuscript read. These three works share one publisher lineage, not three independent witnesses.
4. **CIA remote-viewing file**, [CIA-RDP79-00999A000300080001-3](https://www.cia.gov/readingroom/docs/CIA-RDP79-00999A000300080001-3.pdf), **BPS-S03**. Search-index lead names Swann; the PDF and its pages were not opened. No personal-role or experimental-result claim is promoted from this lead.

Inspected HTML discussion of program history and the institution’s account of its 1995 evaluation. This is later institutional narration, not the original evaluation.

## Bounded claims and disagreement
**BPS-C02** records the estate’s listing of the three works; it does not assert the truth of their contents. **BPS-C03** records CIA’s stated reason for not restoring the program: it considered remote viewing unreliable for intelligence purposes. That retrospective does not independently resolve every laboratory controversy or verify Swann’s memoir. A full evaluation requires the 1995 report, its competing assessments and the actual protocols/data behind a selected claim.

## Fields of sense and neighbors
**SOURCE_LENS:** perception and autobiographical experience, explicitly mediated here through publisher summaries. **DOCUMENTARY lens:** dated protocols, tasking, scoring and correspondence. **CONTRADICTION lens:** distinguish performance under controlled conditions from reported operational usefulness and from extraordinary memoir content. **CONCEPTUAL_NONCAUSAL** adjacency to Puharich is a shared psi research question, not a proven historical relationship. Art may provide a creative donor facet only after a specific work is inspected and its rights assessed.

## Falsifiers and next source gate
Retrieve an edition title page and one relevant primary passage before attributing a precise theory to Swann. For an experimental claim, inspect the complete dated report, target selection, blinding, scoring and unsuccessful trials. For program participation, require an original named role or correspondence, not an estate statement alone. A contrary signed record, revised edition or failed controlled replication could narrow a specific claim. No audio/video played; no primary PDF page inspected. The next bounded action is one original CIA record plus one Swann work passage, not a general proof/disproof of psi.

# Thomas Townsend Brown — source-lead dossier

Brown is represented through identified patent documents and a later original experimental report. Patent language is evidence of what was claimed in a dated application; patent publication does not demonstrate that all proposed mechanisms or uses work. The technical record should precede claims about suppressed technology or secret institutional adoption.

## Works and source leads
1. **US1974483A, Electrostatic motor**, filed 7 February 1930, published 25 September 1934. [Patent reproduction](https://patents.google.com/patent/US1974483A/en), **BPS-S05**. Inspected metadata and extracted opening description/definitions. The text proposes force or motion using high electrostatic potentials. No original page images inspected.
2. **US2949550A, Electrokinetic apparatus**, filed 3 July 1957, published 16 August 1960. [Patent reproduction](https://patents.google.com/patent/US2949550A/en), **BPS-S06**. Inspected metadata and OCR description, especially the opening specification and electrode/medium discussion. Brown describes differently configured electrodes and motion relative to a dielectric medium, including air. The document’s proposed vehicle applications are claims, not evidence of deployed craft.
3. **Thomas B. Bahder and Chris Fazi, Force on an Asymmetric Capacitor**, [arXiv:physics/0211001v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/physics/0211001v2), revised 12 March 2003; repository gives ARL-TR-3005, June 2003. **BPS-S07**. Inspected abstract and metadata only, not the 25-page paper. The authors report four capacitor builds and compare charge-transport explanations; they call for vacuum, pressure and gas-species tests. Their abstract is a bounded experimental counterpoint, not a final verdict on every Brown patent.

## Claim separation
**BPS-C04/C05** record patent identities and dates. **BPS-C06** attributes the electrode/medium proposal to Brown. **BPS-C07** attributes the reported experiment and unresolved mechanism to Bahder/Fazi. These differ from an assertion that gravity was modified: neither the patent identity nor the inspected abstract establishes that proposition. The arXiv revision date and technical-report date are separate fields, not conflicting event dates.

## Fields of sense and relations
**SOURCE_LENS:** inventor specification and proposed applications. **DOCUMENTARY lens:** patent lineage and dated authorship. **ANALYSIS_LENS:** charge transport, medium dependence and test design. Tesla is a **CONCEPTUAL_NONCAUSAL** neighbor for comparison of electrical invention and later reception; no transfer of technology, personal collaboration or suppression campaign is inferred. Later stories may be indexed only after finding an actual author, edition and passage.

The record supports a bibliographic Brown-to-patent relation and a source-attributed proposal. It does not support a Brown-to-covert-program edge. Even a documentary assignment would establish a legal transaction at its date, not automatically operational control or successful deployment.

## Questions and falsifiers
Which experimental results survive controlled vacuum tests and correction for gas-flow/electrostatic measurement artifacts? Do later authors quote the original specification or enlarge its claim? Full report methods, instrument calibration and reproducible replication could support or narrow a mechanism. Original signed contracts would be needed for institutional claims. Next bounded gate: inspect the report’s experimental methods and exact patent figures alongside original page images. Current quality: source-lead dossier, unreviewed; zero audio minutes and zero page images.

This dossier starts with two dated patents and the archive custodian’s finding aid. It neither inventories his complete career nor treats every modern claim using his name as a position he held.

1. **US645576A, System of transmission of electrical energy**, filed 2 September 1897, published 20 March 1900. [Patent reproduction](https://patents.google.com/patent/US645576A/en), **BPS-S08**. Inspected metadata and opening OCR specification. The title and record identify the electrical-transmission proposal; no full technical analysis or original figure inspection performed.
2. **US685957A, Apparatus for the utilization of radiant energy**, filed 21 March 1901, published 5 November 1901. [Patent reproduction](https://patents.google.com/patent/US685957A/en), **BPS-S09**. Inspected OCR specification discussing a radiation-exposed conductor, capacitor and discharge circuit. This is an apparatus claim using incident radiation, not by itself evidence of energy generated without input. Historical particle/ether language must be retained as Tesla’s period explanation rather than silently translated into a modern mechanism.
3. **Nikola Tesla Museum, Activity archive finding aid**, [institutional archive](https://tesla-museum.org/en/legacy/archive/activity/), **BPS-S10**. **BPS-C08/C09** record patent identities and dates; **BPS-C10** attributes the radiant-energy arrangement to the specification. **BPS-C11** records the museum’s described archival categories. A later commentator’s Tesla-derived interpretation would require its own source and claim ID, alongside the particular original it cites. Existing Puharich lecture claims about technological mechanisms remain in their JM owner; they are not retroactively assigned to Tesla. The standard supplies a concrete test for any investigation, including a power-critical one; it does not demand that evidence for competing views be equally strong.

The useful tension is methodological: an opposition-oriented question can uncover material omitted elsewhere, but it does not predetermine the answer. Hearing a witness is not the same as confirming that witness’s account. Personal access, representative sampling, independent documentary support and treatment of contrary testimony must be assessed separately. No professional-misconduct finding follows from this comparison.

## Fields of sense
**SOURCE_LENS:** Baab’s account of critical research. **REPORTING_METHOD:** access, observation and witness selection. **MEDIA_ECONOMICS:** testable incentives and ownership. **CONTRADICTION:** records or testimony that challenge a claim. These fields support discovery while preserving differences between interview, promotional book description and institutional norm.

# Burkhard Heim — Autorendossier

Stand:2026-11-13 · Research Atlas · v1.0.0

**Theorie, Materie und Bewusstsein.** Heim ist hier ein Autor eines weitreichenden Theoriegebäudes. Sein Beitrag liegt im Versuch, Materie, Organisation und Bewusstsein in einer gemeinsamen Strukturlehre zu beschreiben. Das unterscheidet ihn von einer UFO-Fallsammlung und von späteren Antriebsinterpretationen seiner Arbeit.

## Arbeitsweise

Mathematische und begriffliche Systembildung; Ableitung und Strukturvergleich. Originaltexte, von Mitarbeitern verfasste Einführungen, programmierte Formeln und spätere Erweiterungen sind vier verschiedene Quellenarten.

## Themen, Aussagen und Theorien

### Feldantrieb und frühe Kontrabarie

Der Archivführer erschließt das frühe Programm einer Kopplung von Elektromagnetismus und Gravitation für einen rückstoßfreien Antrieb. Das ist ein historisches Theorie- und Technikziel; ein funktionsfähiger Antrieb ist damit nicht dokumentiert. [Heim-Theorien — Übersicht](https://burkhardheim.de/heimtheorien)

### Geometrie und Metron

In der Einführung wird die Materiestruktur geometrisch und diskret gedacht; das Metron bildet eine elementare Flächengröße. Heims sechs Dimensionen sind mathematische Modellgrößen, keine sechs Erscheinungsebenen Vallées. [Einführung in Burkhard Heim: Einheitliche Beschreibung der Welt](https://burkhardheim.de/assets/Burkhard-Heim-1998-Einfuehrung-Einheitliche-Beschreibung-der-Welt.pdf)

### Teilchenmassen

Die überlieferte Fassung von 1982 ist ein konkreter Gleichungstext. Implementierungen und Parameterfragen sind eine eigene Prüfungsebene; hier wurden weder Rechnungen reproduziert noch Messdaten neu ausgewertet. [Die Massenformel nach Burkhard Heim (1982)](https://burkhardheim.de/assets/Massenformel_nach_B_Heim_1982.pdf) · [Massenformel · implementations and critique](https://burkhardheim.de/massenformel)

### Syntrometrie und Organisation

Der Archivführer ordnet Syntrometrie als Heims verallgemeinerte Struktur- und Logiklehre ein. Für den Atlas ist die Verbindung von Physik und Bedeutungsordnung relevant, ohne sie mit einer experimentellen Bewusstseinstheorie gleichzusetzen. [Heim-Theorien — Übersicht](https://burkhardheim.de/heimtheorien)

### Leben

Der Aufsatz beginnt mit einer Beschreibung materieller Systeme über Form, innere Struktur und Zusammensetzung. Die anschließende Übertragung auf Lebensprozesse ist als theoretisches Programm erschlossen. [Der Elementarprozess des Lebens](https://burkhardheim.de/assets/J0054%201976_Heim_Der%20Elementarprozess%20des%20Lebens.pdf)

### Psyche und Fortleben

Heim erklärt im Auftakt von Postmortale Zustände?, indirekt von einer Strukturtheorie auszugehen. Er grenzt sich dort ausdrücklich von paranormalen Erfahrungen als empirischer Ausgangsbasis ab – eine wichtige methodische Differenz zu Erfahrungsberichten. [Postmortale Zustände?](https://burkhardheim.de/assets/J0055%201978_Heim_Postmortale%20Zust%C3%A4nde.pdf)

### Zusammenarbeit und spätere Antriebsmodelle

Die Einführung von 1998 dokumentiert Heim, Dröscher und Resch mit unterschiedlichen Beiträgen. Hauser/Dröschers späterer Antriebspfad ist gesondert zu führen: der erschlossene arXiv-Beitrag von 2011 ist zurückgezogen. Daraus folgt weder eine Widerlegung sämtlicher Heim-Arbeiten noch eine Bestätigung ihrer Technik. [Einführung in Burkhard Heim: Einheitliche Beschreibung der Welt](https://burkhardheim.de/assets/Burkhard-Heim-1998-Einfuehrung-Einheitliche-Beschreibung-der-Welt.pdf) · [Physics of Extreme Gravitomagnetic and Gravity-Like Fields…](https://arxiv.org/abs/1104.3247)
